forecast.limitations: Actual VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate; not billing. Mean scaling uses five base batches and four completed panels plus followups. Current batch05 panel unmeasured; counts can differ. Existing inclusive ranges and processing ranges retained as conditional scenarios, not statistical intervals or caps. Review pauses, provisioning and ancillary storage/transfer/operations excluded from compute mean; failed policy-transition deployment/Mac/pilots remain separate.

calendar_estimate.basis: Retain the prior conditional Saturday 14 November Paris central estimate and late-Friday through Sunday window. Remaining cloud-stage work excludes preflight, retrieval, deeper alternatives, independent reviews and final synthesis; availability and scientific obligations can add time.

forecast.capacity_note: Batch 05 used all eight workers without a failed insertion. Its 1 h 32 min 29 s cloud span is shorter than Batch 04 by 48 min 18 s. Workloads differ, so this is not a controlled hardware comparison. Historical allocation failures remain in earlier receipts.

resource_note: Parent job CPU/wall includes native replay and helper query setup/cleanup. Query subtotals overlap job totals; never add both. VM lifecycle additionally includes idle/provisioning.
